model_under_test: target-blind SMILES hydrogen-bond donor atom counter

comparator_baseline.name: formula-only nitrogen/oxygen heteroatom donor-count baseline
comparator_baseline.prediction_rule: parse only MolecularFormula from the visible projection and predict the count of N plus O atoms as donor atoms, ignoring bonding, protonation, and functional group context

uncertainty.metric: mean absolute error in PubChem HBondDonorCount units
uncertainty.method: integer descriptor exact-match scoring; row residuals must be zero

negative_controls.description: formula-only N+O heteroatom donor baseline is materially worse than the SMILES donor predictor in aggregate
constant zero donor-count sanity control is worse than the SMILES donor predictor in aggregate

falsifiers: SMILES donor-count residual is nonzero, target leaks into visible/comparator inputs, target is formula-mass replay, or aggregate formula-only comparator is not materially worse
